Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the father of Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart (1794–1859) as John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart, who died in 1794. This is a factual error because John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart (1767–1794) was the son of the 1st Marquess of Bute, while Patrick Crichton-Stuart (1794–1859) was the son of the 2nd Marquess of Bute, John Crichton-Stuart. The Planner failed to distinguish between the different generations of the Stuart/Bute family and accepted a genealogical inconsistency (Patrick being born in 1794 if his father died in 1794) without verifying the actual parentage in authoritative peerage sources. This initial misidentification of the father led to the entire subsequent search strategy focusing on the wrong individual (Lord Mount Stuart) rather than the correct father (the 2nd Marquess of Bute), whose death date (22 January 1794) matches the answer key but was derived from the wrong lineage context initially.
